selection: Highest mean full local total among challengers with mean raw neighborhood MMD at most1.05x v25 and mean raw variogram at most1.10x v25, full format/marginal guards. Inspect library tails and correlation concentration as diagnostics. If none eligible, report conflict to parent without expanding search or selecting after another new test.
limitations: Previously used development stage reused; three-seed variation is sampling repeatability not independent stages; hyperparameter selection optimistic. No promise of official gain.
practical_gain_guard: Before examining any scores, require mean total gain >0.1 local points and paired gain >0 for each of the3 fixed seeds; deterministic ties within0.05 choose lower blend, then global over newly fitted model. If none eligible, report to parent without additional sweep.
small_state_rule: Within-state Gaussian ranks pooled across endpoints by state (not stage×state). Singletons produce zero rank residual; every state contributes to same pooled covariance. Application skips carrier states n<4 as inherited regularize.
